snippet.title: Heat Sand Race
snippet.description:
It’s a 3D race full of action and adrenaline and your goal: destroying other racing cars in the battle racing,  and be the first at the finish in the circuit races.
Fasten your seat-belt into this awesome racing games "Heat Sand Race" and roll on the track, chasing other cars.

Game: http://www.playcombo.com/games/playcombo-games/race-playcombo/Heat-Sand-Race.html
